ns2:course.label: Intermediate Personal Fin Plan
ns2:course.description: Financial planning philosophies, techniques, and procedures. Course uses case studies and problem-solving activities to construct financial plans for individuals and families in various life cycle stages and family structures. Prerequisite: ACE 240, ECON 302, and junior standing or consent of instructor; FIN 230 is recommended.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ACE 240, ECON 302, and junior standing or consent of instructor; FIN 230 is recommended.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing. Restricted to BS:ACE-Con Econ & Finance-UIUC or BS: ACE: Finl Planning -UIUC.
